bias_targets.methodology: Conducting qualitative user interviews and quantitative online surveys to compare the task priorities, unmet needs, and demographic profiles of chat model non-adopters versus frequent adopters.
Using two-proportion z-tests on online survey data to measure the disparity in chat model adoption rates across different educational attainment levels and income groups.
Analyzing survey demographic data to compare the rates of chat model adoption between populations living in rural, suburban, and urban areas.

Comparing chat model adoption rates between men and women via survey data, and identifying the under-representation of historically feminized tasks (such as domestic labor and caregiving) in current LLM development and evaluation.
